text: Don’t remember the former things, and don’t consider the things of old. Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Don’t you know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
“For I know the thoughts that I think toward you,” says Yahweh, “thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you hope and a future.”
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.
So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before, I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?
We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.
And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men, knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Let us acknowledge Yahweh. Let us press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth.

You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden. Neither do you light a lamp, and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house. Even so, let your light shine before men; that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father who is in heaven.
A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.
As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
We love him, because he first loved us.
Yahweh appeared of old to me, saying, “Yes, I have loved you with an everlasting love. Therefore I have drawn you with loving kindness.”
But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Let all that you do be done in love.
Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God, and knows God. He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
Can a woman forget her nursing child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? Yes, these may forget, yet I will not forget you!
Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another. By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.
How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers, nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you. Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.
But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.
Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
“For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my loving kindness will not depart from you, and my covenant of peace will not be removed,” says Yahweh who has mercy on you.
And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.
Yahweh is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness. Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.
Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
“All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.
But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret, and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.

No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, Yahweh, my rock, and my redeemer.
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise; redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.
The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win. Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger; for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.
For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
“Come now, and let us reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow. Though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.”
And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.
As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.
For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.
I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake; and I will not remember your sins.
Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.
Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.
He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.
Tear your heart, and not your garments, and turn to Yahweh, your God; for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, and relents from sending calamity.
I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions, and, as a cloud, your sins. Return to me, for I have redeemed you.
Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.
Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.
Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.
Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.
Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was on him; and by his wounds we are healed.
He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies. Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.
But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.
He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”
You shall call on me, and you shall go and pray to me, and I will listen to you. You shall seek me, and find me, when you search for me with all your heart.
Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.
For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.
Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.

In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you. If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.
For nothing spoken by God is impossible.
“Yahweh is my portion,” says my soul. “Therefore I will hope in him.”
But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.
Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
Blessed is the man who trusts in Yahweh, and whose confidence is in Yahweh.
Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.
But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”
I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.
I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of Yahweh in the land of the living. Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.
He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.
See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I that live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me, and gave himself up for me.
Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.
No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.
For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.
No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.
But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
But now Yahweh who created you, Jacob, and he who formed you, Israel says: “Don’t be afraid, for I have redeemed you. I have called you by your name. You are mine.”
I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”
For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
But now, Yahweh, you are our Father. We are the clay, and you our potter. We all are the work of your hand.
My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me. I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.
Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.
Don’t you know that you are a temple of God, and that God’s Spirit lives in you?
But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest. Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls. For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.

Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters. He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you rest.”
Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.
He said to them, “You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.
My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done. God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil; for he gives sleep to his loved ones.
For, behold, the winter is past. The rain is over and gone. The flowers appear on the earth. The time of the singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things, but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”
For I have satiated the weary soul, and I have replenished every sorrowful soul.
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you, Yahweh alone, make me live in safety.
He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.
But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.
Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.
The fear of Yahweh leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.
There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God. For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.
Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.”
My people will live in a peaceful habitation, in safe dwellings, and in quiet resting places.
It is good that a man should hope and quietly wait for the salvation of Yahweh.
Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.
After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.
Better is little, with the fear of Yahweh, than great treasure with trouble.
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?
For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.
But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be burned, and flame will not scorch you.
The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.
I, even I, am he who comforts you. Who are you, that you are afraid of man who shall die, and of the son of man who will be made as grass?
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.
Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.
For the Lord Yahweh will help me. Therefore I have not been confounded. Therefore I have set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be disappointed.
You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.
He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in Yahweh.
Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.
Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”
Don’t fear, neither be afraid. Haven’t I declared it to you long ago, and shown it? You are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? Indeed, there is not. I don’t know any other Rock.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.
He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don’t give up.

Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations, knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance. Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.
Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.

For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no food; the flocks are cut off from the fold, and there is no herd in the stalls: yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.
In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.
God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.
Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.
Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.
Yahweh, be gracious to us. We have waited for you. Be our strength every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.
You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God. And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time; casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.
Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.
Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.
In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.
Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.
Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.
He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a dimly burning wick. He will faithfully bring justice.
Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?
Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.
From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort; who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”
Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul. Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
You came near in the day that I called on you. You said, “Don’t be afraid.”
Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
As one whom his mother comforts, so will I comfort you. You will be comforted in Jerusalem.
If we are faithless, he remains faithful. For he can’t deny himself.
My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.
But seek first God’s Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.
Give us today our daily bread.
The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.
See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?
Yahweh is good to those who wait for him, to the soul who seeks him.
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season. You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.
Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.”

Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin, yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it. I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.
Ask of Yahweh rain in the spring time, Yahweh who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.
While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?
You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.
Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.
But godliness with contentment is great gain.

“For my thoughts are not your thoughts, and your ways are not my ways,” says Yahweh. “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.”
From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
You will have plenty to eat, and be satisfied, and will praise the name of Yahweh, your God, who has dealt wondrously with you; and my people will never again be disappointed.
He who has a generous eye will be blessed; for he shares his food with the poor.
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works, not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.

Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.
Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.
Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.
Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.
A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.
They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.
Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.
See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.
If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.
Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.
Let brotherly love continue. Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.
So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.
The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct you in the good and the right way.
A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.
Rejoice always. Pray without ceasing. In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.
This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
Praise Yahweh, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
Oh give thanks to Yahweh. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
Yahweh, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him, rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.
Oh taste and see that Yahweh is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!
Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

I will greatly rejoice in Yahweh! My soul will be joyful in my God; for he has clothed me with the garments of salvation. He has covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decks himself with a garland, and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.
Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.

Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For Yahweh is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.
Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
Sing to Yahweh, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.

I will tell of the loving kindnesses of Yahweh and the praises of Yahweh, according to all that Yahweh has given to us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he has given to them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.
For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!
Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy, to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.
“Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.
You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace, because he trusts in you.
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. Those who lived in the land of the shadow of death, on them the light has shined.
Yahweh will give strength to his people. Yahweh will bless his people with peace.
If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.
How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news, who publishes peace, who brings good news, who proclaims salvation, who says to Zion, “Your God reigns!”
The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
For you shall go out with joy, and be led out with peace. The mountains and the hills will break out before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields will clap their hands.
Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.
Yahweh, you will ordain peace for us, for you have also done all our work for us.
Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.
Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you.
Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.
“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel”; which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”
For to us a child is born. To us a son is given; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful, Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people. For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.”
Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.
The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.
The work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of righteousness, quietness and confidence forever.
So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
Yahweh bless you, and keep you. Yahweh make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you. Yahweh lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.
Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.
